basics.name: Woongjib Choi
basics.label: Incoming Ph.D. Student
basics.summary: Bridging classic signal processing and deep learning, with research interests spanning **audio and speech processing**, **audio compression**, **digital signal processing**, and **generative models**.

courses: Thesis: A Multi-Rate Audio Super-Resolution Framework Using Flow Matching Without Neural Vocoders
Includes two-year mandatory military service (Apr. 2020 – Oct. 2021)

work.name: DSPAI Lab, Yonsei University
work.summary: Conducted research on neural audio codecs, tokenization, and generative models for audio under Prof. Hong-Goo Kang.
highlights: Collaborated with Prof. Yongshik Lee on vehicle state classification from unintentional electromagnetic emissions, including STFT-based signal analysis and DNN-based classification.

work.name: DSPAI Lab, Yonsei University
work.summary: Conducted research on neural audio codecs, audio super-resolution, and generative models under Prof. Hong-Goo Kang.
highlights: Developed bandwidth extension methods via flow matching and self-supervised representations.

**ETRI-Yonsei Joint Research Project**: Led development of DNN-based post-processing for legacy audio codecs. Served as project leader in the final 6 months, resulting in 1 int'l conference paper, 1 domestic paper, and 1 patent application.

work.name: Yonsei University, Department of Electrical and Electronic Engineering
work.summary: Served as a Teaching Assistant for various undergraduate courses in the Department of Electrical and Electronic Engineering.
highlights: EEE4610: Capstone Design (Fall 2024) — Advised project on unified speech enhancement bridging personalized and unconditional models.

work.name: SRIP Lab, Yonsei University
work.summary: Implemented classical and deep learning-based image processing algorithms including white balancing, denoising, demosaicing, and super-resolution under the supervision of Prof. Moon Gi Kang.
highlights: Undergraduate thesis: A Technical Overview of Deep Learning-Based Single-Image Super-Resolution Methods
